:root { --ink:#17211c; --green:#176b4d; --lime:#d9f99d; --cream:#fffdf7; --muted:#66736b; --line:#e5e9e1; }

a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .wrap { width:min(1120px,calc(100% - 40px)); margin:auto; }

nav { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:24px; } .brand { font-weight:800; font-size:1.3rem; } .brand span { color:var(--green); }
.links { display:flex; gap:24px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.94rem; } .bag { border:1px solid var(--ink); padding:10px 14px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; }

.hero { padding:78px 0 56px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr; gap:48px; align-items:center; } .tag { color:var(--green); font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.11em; font-size:.75rem; }

h1 { font-size:clamp(2.7rem,6vw,5.5rem); line-height:.95; letter-spacing:-.065em; margin:15px 0 22px; max-width:650px; } .hero p { font-size:1.1rem; line-height:1.65; color:var(--muted); max-width:490px; }

.actions { display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:30px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .button { display:inline-block; padding:15px 21px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:800; } .primary { color:white; background:var(--green); } .secondary { border:1px solid var(--ink); }

.visual { min-height:410px; border-radius:24px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d9f99d,#fef3c7); padding:28px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; } .visual div { font-size:clamp(9rem,18vw,14rem); filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15)); transform:rotate(-8deg); }

.trust { border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:20px 0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.9rem; } .trust b { color:var(--ink); }

section { padding:70px 0; } .heading { display:flex; align-items:end; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; margin-bottom:28px; } h2 { margin:0; font-size:2rem; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .heading a { color:var(--green); font-weight:800; }
